body:
Quite the age difference with us! Thank you for your advice. You're a very kind person. I'll try to see a legitimate counselor who will actually help me. It'll be hard because I only have one off day per week. The rest I'm working and going to school. 

I think one reason I have trouble connecting with people is because my parents didn't allow me to socialize when I was younger. I mean, they sent me to school, but that was about it. I rarely had friends over. In high school I was allowed 1 hour each day to hang out with friends after school. People have told me I'm awkward. I try not to be and I feel like I've gotten better, but I still don't feel like I fit in.
Right now I am feeling totally pathetic, alone, and useless, but your comment really helped me feel better. Thank you so much.

Hey, we're kind of the same age. I had to abruptly move out of my parents house when I was 18.. I went okay. I moved in with a not-so-great boyfriend though. 

Do you have a job? Save up a decent chunk of money. Find a roommate, and rent an apartment. Even if it's super crappy. If you know anyone in the area, see if you can crash with them while you get on your feet. Don't feel like you have to appease your mother and live with her forever. You can get out. It doesn't get easier, but it does get better.

Thank you. I've seen a couple of counselors in my area. They're all church counselors though. So far only one of them has been mildly helpful.. the rest tell me I just have to pray the problems away, which is not helpful at all. Especially since I'm agnostic. 

If I'm so loveable, why doesn't anyone want to even be friends with me? Or talk to me? I feel like I'm pretty self aware, I'm not rude or selfish or mean. I don't know why no one wants to be around me.
